name: 57006 · Brookings, SD
findings: ZIP 57006 (Brookings) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57006 (Brookings) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
